title: lycopodium magellanicum var. maius
intro: Lycopodium magellanicum var. maius, commonly known as Club Moss, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium magellanicum var. maius include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate coughs, colds, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
